source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-26

procedures.title: Corvette telescoping steering column: assemble
steps: (continued) ...then the clip, spring, coupling and retainer clip on the bottom of the shaft.
Carefully slide the shaft into the lower end of the jacket.
Fit the bearing retainer over the lower ends of the shaft and jacket and secure it with 3 screws.
Fit the flange and flange bolt to the shaft's lower end.
Thread the turn signal switch wires through the switch cover, set the switch and upper bearing housing in the cover, and fasten the switch with its 3 screws.
Start the escutcheon and wiring protector, with the switch wires, over the end of the outer jacket.
Slide the inner jacket section into the outer section.
Tighten the signal switch screws to fasten the switch cover to the inner jacket flange.
Fasten the bottom of the wiring protector to the column with 2 screws.
Assemble the keys and bumper, set the assembly in the jacket, and fit the bumper key strap.
Place the wave washer, thrust washer and upper retaining ring at the top of the shaft; seat the ring in its groove with a screwdriver.
Fit the turn signal lever with its screw and screw in the hazard warning knob.
If removed, wrap the mesh cover around the jacket's mesh section and tape it with electrical or friction tape.
Slide the cancelling cam and upper bearing preload spring over the top of the shaft.

procedures.title: Steering column: install
steps: Before fitting the column, slide the dash panel seals, covers, plates and clamps loosely onto it in their order (see figures 17 to 20 in the manual).
Move the seat fully back, then carefully work the column into place in the car and at the steering gear.
notes: Fit the instrument panel mounting bracket loosely only; do not tighten it until the steering coupling is connected.
